key.name: refresh-mode
key.description: One of "60", "90" or "adaptive". 60 Hz saves power but the NT36523 reports the stylus as a finger at 60 Hz, so pressure and tilt are unavailable. 90 Hz is required for the native stylus mode. Adaptive uses 90 Hz while the screen is changing or input is arriving and drops to 60 Hz after a period of a static screen; it also holds 90 Hz for several minutes after stylus use.
